notes.text: The final paragraph reports about 250 pages ready, hopes for another “env.” 200/300 pages for SGA 4 in two or three months, and projects 450 à 500 pages in five or six months. The writer qualifies the forecast: “J’espère”, then “Cependant je ne peux le garantir”; it depends on Mr. Verdier at Brandeis “cette année”. No date is inferred from that wording.

brief_feedback: None affecting the reading. Correction-order uncertainty is recorded explicitly when both overtyped characters can be seen but their temporal order cannot; a visible heavier impression alone is not silently treated as a different original character.
workflow_observation: All three agree on Manuscripts, sécrétaire and the cancelled Roman letters. They differ on underprint certainty, preferred order, surname confidence and frame geometry; main crop decisions retain nine unresolved loci. Half-settled differences needed source bboxes for main review.
adjudication_note: The complete main reading is r1’s reading after independent crop adjudication, not a majority selection. Every witness discrepancy was inspected on a retained crop. The three readers differ materially at the first underlined count, preferred VI B overprint order, Appendice undertrace preference, Saarbach certainty, the cancelled r after mise, and frame geometry; the rows above preserve their alternatives. The three encodings of the ei/ie transposition convey the same ink. Changes in doubt state are included in the counts and are not all categorical witness errors.
